comment: Android's shared storage for the Linux desktop's files. Android provides /storage/emulated/0/Plasma (MediaProvider's FUSE), which rungic-plasma-enter binds to /mnt/plasma-shared and the container (system/plasma.config) to /mnt/android-shared; system/shared-storage (rungic-plasma-shared.service) re-mounts it with bindfs as ~/Shared of the desktop account (owned by it, writable, shared writable mmap for SQLite WAL, docs/69). The Linux consumer system/user-dirs (/usr/libexec/rungic-user-dirs, run by the session and by account-prepare) refuses an unmounted ~/Shared, creates the shared standard directories in it, links ~/NAME -> Shared/NAME unless the user has their own, and sets the XDG mapping; programs then save into them (screen recordings into Videos). The provider check only reads: the mounts, write permission (access(2), nothing is written) and the links. Tested from both ends: tools/tests/test_contract_shared_storage.py (the real user-dirs against a stand-in mount) and acceptance scenario contract.shared-storage.

queries.name: user-dirs
queries.command: for d in Downloads Music Pictures Videos Templates Public; do [ -L "$HOME/$d" ] || continue; [ "$(readlink -f "$HOME/$d")" = "$(readlink -f "$HOME/Shared/$d")" ] || { echo "$d does not lead into Shared"; exit 1; }; done; [ "$(xdg-user-dir VIDEOS)" = "$HOME/Videos" ] && [ "$(xdg-user-dir DOWNLOAD)" = "$HOME/Downloads" ]
